description: Soft-delete a billing subtask and its time entries into the recycle bin, where an admin can restore them together. Returns a preview unless confirm=true is set.

confirm.description: Set true to perform the action. Omit or false returns a preview only — nothing is written.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

subtask_id.description: Id of the subtask to delete.

name: delete_subtask
title: Delete subtask
